notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market KM SaaS (search-driven product recommendations + internal knowledge search). Interest started with hosted API for quick integration, then shifted to Dedicated if sustained throughput/SLAs. Key ask: a dedicated rerank endpoint (one-shot rerank API) that can accept pre-scored candidates and return reordered top-K with confidence scores. Prefers simple REST, streaming not required for rerank.

Summary of customer voice / shorthand notes:
- "We need predictable ranking quality — offline eval first, then live canary." (Product lead)
- latency target: 95th <= 120ms for rerank path (most queries short, top-K=20).
- throughput target: 150-250 QPS during peak; burst to 500 QPS for short windows.
- cost: moderate sensitivity — willing to pay for Dedicated if unit economics clear.
- evaluation metrics: MRR / NDCG / precision@5. Will provide labelled eval set (~25k queries) for offline scoring and regression checks.
- reranking approach: two-stage retrieval -> scoring. Wants Redwood rerank endpoint to accept sparse candidates + feature vectors + optional context. Offline scoring run must match production weights.
- model preference: tested small open LLMs + sim-based embeddings; open to Redwood-verified models (quantized) for cost reasons. Wants fallback to smaller, cheaper variant if capacity constrained.
- security: SSO + audit logs mandatory; data residency: US only for now; KMS integration required for Dedicated.
- integrations: will pipe events to internal observability and tag tokens for cost allocation.
- governance: needs retention controls and ability to purge PII from logs on demand.

Sales/POC notes:
- 2026-02-18 demo (hosted api rerank sketch) -> positive. Product engineer liked the rerank REST prototype. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_auriga_initial_demo.
- 2026-02-25 security questionnaire submitted; security team expects SOC2 docs + sample audit logs.
- 2026-03-03 provided eval set upload instructions; awaiting sanitized dataset.
- Pricing convo 2026-03-05 — AE walked through hosted usage tiers; customer asked for Dedicated baseline pricing to compare.
- POC ask: 2-week hosted rerank POC + a Dedicated pricing proposal/estimation if metrics meet SLOs.

Open questions to resolve:
- exact per-query cost model for their two-stage flow (retrieval + rerank) and how batching affects unit costs.
- acceptable SLA for 99th percentile and SLO breach penalty language.
- test harness for offline scoring reproducibility (seed management + deterministic scoring).

Steno / one-liners for next meeting:
- POC kickoff: get sanitized eval set, set up test credentials, run baseline on hosted rerank endpoint.
- SE to propose candidate batching strategy and expected cost delta if use quantized model.
- Legal/Security to align on SOC2 artifacts + KMS integration doc.
